svg.text: Same height, same scale. Each white line is one 0.2 mm layer.
Turns from first catch to shoulder
The fine ridges are only about 4 layers, and the shallow flank turns each layer
into a big radial step. That fits your prints: 0.35 struggles, 0.45 is loose.
A coarse ridge fixes both: more layers in each ridge, and steps that stay small.
Same idea, thicker ridges. Turn left-hand 0.6 turn
up to the shoulder, with the tool slot to hold it.
Side cut through the valve axis
Seen from the valve (nut left out)
Plug goes straight in, printed fork slides across
from the side and locks it. Flats stop it turning.
